clauses.statement: Every decision record that mints a budget_approval must also write a tracked decision document under docs/management/decisions/ with frontmatter type budget_override_approval, and record that document's repo-relative path as budget_approval.decision_doc, so the grantor, override digest, and timestamp of an owner grant are reviewable in the PR diff.
clauses.rationale: The workspace decision store (.vibepro/pr/) is gitignored; a grant recorded only there never reaches the reviewer, silently superseding the repository's tracked budget_override_approval channel.

test_refs.case: BGT-S-1/S-2 a budget grant writes a tracked decision document cross-referenced from budget_approval

test_pattern.must_cover: tracked decision document cross-referenced from budget_approval

clauses.statement: When the tracked decision document path is gitignored, recording the budget grant must fail before the workspace decision store is written; a budget grant must never fall back silently to the untracked channel alone.
clauses.rationale: Fail-closed on the reviewability channel: an environment whose .gitignore swallows docs/management/decisions/ would otherwise reproduce the original finding invisibly.

test_refs.case: BGT-S-3 a budget grant fails when the tracked document path is gitignored

test_pattern.must_cover: fails when the tracked document path is gitignored

clauses.statement: Re-recording a grant for the same story and unchanged override content overwrites the same document path deterministically, while a grant over changed override content produces a new file whose name embeds the new digest prefix, so a changed budget appears in the diff as a new file rather than an easily-missed edit.
clauses.rationale: The filename digest makes budget changes structurally visible in review.

test_pattern.must_cover: a changed budget produces a new file

clauses.statement: A decision record without a budget grant writes no document and its output shape is unchanged; resolveBudgetOverrideAuthority does not inspect decision_doc, so existing grants and grandfathered overrides resolve exactly as before.
clauses.rationale: The change adds a reviewability channel without touching enforcement semantics.
